items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he's the architect that I most, he and Strayhorn.

ctx.x: Because had I'd gone with Monk, he's the architect that I most, he and Strayhorn. Something about those guys as composers, and as having a whirl, Monk was somebody. I was scared to death of him. I wouldn't go up to his house. You know if he had said "Hey Charles." But Monk wouldn't do any of that stuff, but I think it would've been, I still play songs to him all the time on my recordings.
